primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in Enhanced Liver Fibrosis score at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: Mean changes were −0.071 (0.3 mg), 0.125 (1 mg), −0.213 (3 mg), and 0.263 (placebo); no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/7 (0.3 mg), 11/42 (1 mg; 1 death), 5/55 (3 mg), and 3/56 (placebo; 0 deaths).
